name: Ui_Window_ApplyTextEvent
summary: Shared window text-event applier: on event kind 1 it marks the window open, binds the u16 text id at event+2 through 0x002F6B0C and forwards event+4/+8/+9 to the embedded window; otherwise it marks the window closed and tail-calls the base handler.
evidence: Four independent named callers from different UI subsystems use it as their text-binding step - Ui_EquipMenu_ApplySelection, Ui_PokerWindow_BindCardText, Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState and Ui_ItemIcon_PlaceInLine - and its callee is the confident Ui_Widget_ResolveChildPointerByName, which is exactly the shared-helper pattern FACTS.md describes. The body itself is damaged decompilation (invented inR4/inR6/inR9 registers), so the field-level details stay unverified and only the role is promoted.

name: maybe_Ui_ItemInfoWindow_ChildWindow_Dtor
